n5d73325537.headline: Iraq to insist that Local Transactions are in Dinars | Iraq Business News
n5d73325537.summary: The Central Bank of Iraq said all transactions inside the country will need to be made in Iraqi dinars from 2024, rather than US dollars. The bank announced the plan under its governor.
n5d73325537.why: Currency rules for domestic payments affect dollar demand, banking flows and monetary policy in Iraq, a major oil exporter.
